body: PREMERGE POLICY MIGRATION — effective when cand-2G3GBE7ZDZN0JP5YKD9869YDA0 / 79c lands. The hardened checker requires the supplied gate-log digest to be bound by exactly one candidate evidence record named chief-merged-tree-gate, produced by the landing actor and bound to the candidate OID/ref. Mote candidate evidence record accepts a producer only when the immutable candidate policy declares that name/kind/producer. Therefore an older row may report landable=true yet still be unlandable through the chief court if its policy predates this external requirement. Do not add evidence by impersonation or bypass the gate. For each candidate actually selected for landing, create a current-main successor that declares chief-merged-tree-gate:external:codex-storymodel4s-chief plus its Git-ancestry producer, re-run/carry no reviews, produce the candidate-bound gate receipt, and supersede the old row. This applies to the apparently ready 5T2 and 0PQ rows too. I am pipelining the P0 Sherlock six-path successor now; this is a governance-policy recut, not a content defect or a request to recut all 39 rows at once.
